prompt: Build a small class that splits an ordered dataset into a training set and a test set by index, keeping rows and labels together and rejecting impossible splits. Complete the DataSplitter class in the starter file.
explanation: Splitting by index is the simplest train/test split: the first trainCount samples train the model and the rest are held back to measure it. The only arithmetic to get right is the offset -- test sample i is dataset row trainCount + i -- and the only invariant is that a row and its label are always fetched with the same index. Validating in the constructor means every later call can trust the stored state instead of re-checking it.
hints: testSize() is rows.length - trainCount; it does not need a field of its own.
testRow(i) and testLabel(i) both need the offset trainCount + i.
Do the validation first: throw new IllegalArgumentException(...) before assigning any field.
